method: Fresh Windows x64 runner executing hash-pinned, unchanged original assemblies. Dialog workers, actual Coding CaseList constructor and file serializers are distinct from retained visible GUI comparisons.

loginGeneration.randomNormalization: Only generated code bodies and group suffixes; prefixes, lengths, uniqueness, passwords, modes, counts and preserved identities compared.

bookletValidation.comparison: Complete progress/error messages, failure outcome and all generated XML fields.

codingResults.comparison: All decoded result header fields, global comments, codes, comments, timestamps and entry order. Export and original constructor reload/re-export.

excel.input: Three synthetic people with empty/A/B subforms; every sheet and cell compared, styles and ZIP metadata excluded.

fixes.issue: Empty shared-string passwords were repaired by ExcelJS when saving Windows-mode login workbooks; a subsequent XML export changed login modes.
fixes.change: Windows-mode workbook output retains the original cell representation; repeated reopen/export matches the original.

limitations: Finite products over the listed dimensions, not all possible files or option values.
Synthetic data and official templates only; no empirical study files supplied.
These new worker/file comparisons do not add visible Windows-GUI pairs for every combination.
The three existing GUI qualifications and pure-online operating-system limits remain documented in release.json.
Actual random login values, workbook styles and archive metadata are not required to match byte-for-byte.
Absent and empty Testlet label attributes are treated as the same empty label.
The two invalid XML string cases compare rejection outcomes; their exception messages are not asserted identical.
Coding constructor pairs compare serialized results; the newly generated matrices do not assert identical native case-list counts or GUI selection for every synthetic state.
